info.title: Gemini AI
info.description: API reference for Gemini AI on Ace Data Cloud.

id.description: A unique identifier for the chat completion.

model.description: The model used for the chat completion.

object.description: The object type, which is always `chat.completion`.

index.description: The index of the choice in the list of choices.

role.description: The role of the author of this message.

id.description: The ID of the tool call.

type.description: The type of the tool call. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as generated by the model in JSON format.

function.description: The function that the model called.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model, such as function calls.

refusal.description: The refusal message generated by the model.

id.description: Unique identifier for this audio response.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) for when this audio response will no longer be accessible on the server for use in multi-turn conversations.

data.description: Base64 encoded audio bytes generated by the model.

transcript.description: Transcript of the audio generated by the model.

audio.description: If the audio output modality is requested, this object contains data about the audio response from the model.

message.description: A chat completion message generated by the model.

finish_reason.description:
The reason the model stopped generating tokens. This will be `stop` if the model hit a natural stop point or a provided stop sequence,
`length` if the maximum number of tokens specified in the request was reached,
`content_filter` if content was omitted due to a flag from our content filters,
`tool_calls` if the model called a tool, or `function_call` (deprecated) if the model called a function.

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the choice.

choices.description: A list of chat completion choices. Can be more than one if `n` is greater than 1.

created.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the chat completion was created.

system_fingerprint.description:
This fingerprint represents the backend configuration that the model runs with.

Can be used in conjunction with the `seed` request parameter to understand when backend changes have been made that might impact determinism.

prompt_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the prompt.

completion_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the generated completion.

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens used in the request (prompt + completion).

cached_tokens.description: Cached tokens present in the prompt.

audio_tokens.description: Audio input tokens present in the prompt.

prompt_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in the prompt.

reasoning_tokens.description: Tokens generated by the model for reasoning.

audio_tokens.description: Audio output tokens generated by the model.

accepted_prediction_tokens.description: When using Predicted Outputs, the number of tokens in the prediction that appeared in the completion.

rejected_prediction_tokens.description: When using Predicted Outputs, the number of tokens in the prediction that did not appear in the completion.

completion_tokens_details.description: Breakdown of tokens used in a completion.

usage.description: Usage statistics for the completion request.

schema.description: Represents a chat completion response returned by model, based on the provided input.

error.message: The specified token is not matched with API.

message.example: The specified token is not matched with API.

trace_id.description: The trace id of this request.
The trace id of this request.

400.description: Bad request, possibly due to missing or invalid parameters.

error.message: The specified token is invalid or wrong.

message.example: The specified token is invalid or wrong.

trace_id.description: The trace id of this request.

401.description: Unauthorized, invalid or missing authorization token.

error.message: You have exceeded the rate limit.

message.example: You have exceeded the rate limit.

trace_id.description: The trace id of this request.

429.description: Too many requests, you have exceeded the rate limit.

trace_id.description: The trace id of this request.

500.description: Internal server error, something went wrong on the server.

parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: Specifies the format of the response from the server.

n.description: How many chat completion choices to generate for each input message.

model.description: ID of the model to use.

stream.description: If set, partial message deltas will be sent, like in ChatGPT.

oneOf.description: The text contents of the message.

type.description: The type of the content part.
The type of the content part.

url.description: Either a URL of the image or the base64 encoded image data.

detail.description: Specifies the detail level of the image.

image_url.description: The image URL or base64 encoded image data.

oneOf.description: An array of content parts with a defined type. Can contain text and image_url inputs.

content.description: The contents of the message. Can be a string for text-only messages, or an array of content parts for multimodal messages (text and image_url).

name.description: An optional name for the participant. Provides the model information to differentiate between participants of the same role.

id.description: The ID of the tool call.

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

arguments.description: The arguments to call the function with, as generated by the model in JSON format.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls generated by the model in a previous turn, when `role` is `assistant`. Echo this back along with a `tool` message containing the tool call result.

refusal.description: The refusal message by the assistant. Used when `role` is `assistant`.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call that this message is responding to. Required when role is `tool`.

messages.description: A list of messages comprising the conversation so far.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens that can be generated in the chat completion.

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

oneOf.description: JSON Object response format. Must instruct the model to produce JSON in the prompt.

type.description: Enables Structured Outputs which ensures the model matches the supplied JSON schema.

name.description: The name of the response format. Must be a-z, A-Z, 0-9, or contain underscores and dashes.

description.description: A description of what the response format is for.

schema.description: The schema for the response format, described as a JSON Schema object.

strict.description: Whether to enable strict schema adherence.

oneOf.description: Structured Outputs response format using a JSON Schema.

response_format.description: An object specifying the format that the model must output. Setting to `{ "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": {...} }` enables Structured Outputs. Setting to `{ "type": "json_object" }` enables the older JSON Object mode.

top_p.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered. We generally recommend altering this or `temperature` but not both.

frequency_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

presence_penalty.description: Number between -2.0 and 2.0. Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

seed.description: If specified, our system will make a best effort to sample deterministically, such that repeated requests with the same `seed` and parameters should return the same result. Determinism is not guaranteed; refer to `system_fingerprint` in the response to monitor backend changes.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences where the API will stop generating further tokens. The returned text will not contain the stop sequence.

max_completion_tokens.description: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a completion, including visible output tokens and reasoning tokens. This supersedes `max_tokens` for newer models (o1/o3/o4/gpt-5 series and any other reasoning model).

logprobs.description: Whether to return log probabilities of the output tokens or not. If true, returns the log probabilities of each output token returned in the `content` of `message`.

top_logprobs.description: An integer between 0 and 20 specifying the number of most likely tokens to return at each token position, each with an associated log probability. `logprobs` must be set to `true` if this parameter is used.

include_usage.description: If set, an additional chunk will be streamed before the `data: [DONE]` message. The `usage` field on this chunk shows the token usage statistics for the entire request, and the `choices` field will always be an empty array.

stream_options.description: Options for streaming response. Only set this when you set `stream: true`.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether to enable parallel function calling during tool use.

user.description: A unique identifier representing your end-user, which can help OpenAI to monitor and detect abuse.

reasoning_effort.description: Constrains effort on reasoning for reasoning models (o1/o3/o4/gpt-5 series). Currently supported values are `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, and `high`. Reducing reasoning effort can result in faster responses and fewer tokens used on reasoning in a response.

service_tier.description: Specifies the processing type used for serving the request. Set to `auto` to let OpenAI pick, `default` for the standard pricing/performance, `flex` for the slower-but-cheaper Flex Processing tier, or `priority` for the fastest tier on supported models.

store.description: Whether or not to store the output of this chat completion request for use in OpenAI's model distillation or evals products.

metadata.description: Set of 16 key-value pairs that can be attached to an object. Useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Keys are strings up to 64 characters; values are strings up to 512 characters.

logit_bias.description: Modify the likelihood of specified tokens appearing in the completion. Accepts a JSON object that maps tokens (specified by their token ID in the tokenizer) to an associated bias value from -100 to 100.

modalities.description: Output types that you would like the model to generate. Most models default to `["text"]`. The `gpt-4o-audio-preview` model can also be used to generate audio. To request that this model generate both text and audio responses, you can use `["text", "audio"]`.

voice.description: The voice the model uses to respond.

audio.description: Parameters for audio output. Required when audio output is requested with `modalities: ["audio"]`.

type.description: The type of the predicted content. Always `content`.

oneOf.description: The content used for the prediction.

content.description: The content used for the prediction.

prediction.description: Static predicted output content, such as the content of a text file that is being regenerated. Used to improve response time when most of the response is known ahead of time.

search_context_size.description: High level guidance for the amount of context window space to use for the search.

user_location.description: Approximate location parameters for the search.

web_search_options.description: Options for the web search tool, used by GPT-4o models with built-in search (`gpt-4o-search-preview`, `gpt-4o-mini-search-preview`).

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to be called.

description.description: A description of what the function does.

parameters.description: The parameters the function accepts, described as a JSON Schema object.

tools.description: A list of tools the model may call. Currently, only functions are supported as a tool.

oneOf.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model.

type.description: The type of the tool. Currently, only `function` is supported.

name.description: The name of the function to call.

oneOf.description: Specifies a tool the model should use.

tool_choice.description: Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. `none` means the model will not call any tool. `auto` means the model can pick between generating a message or calling one or more tools. `required` means the model must call one or more tools.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model to use for content generation. Format: model name (without `models/` prefix).

contents.description: The content of the current conversation with the model. For single-turn queries, this is a single instance. For multi-turn queries (chat), this is a repeated field that contains conversation history and the latest request.

role.description: The role of the content producer. Must be 'user' or 'model'.

parts.description: Ordered parts that constitute a single message.

mimeType.description: The IANA standard MIME type of the source data.

functionCall.description: A predicted FunctionCall returned from the model.

functionResponse.description: The result output of a FunctionCall.

generationConfig.description: Configuration options for model generation and outputs.

stopSequences.description: Character sequences that will stop output generation (up to 5).

responseMimeType.description: MIME type of the generated candidate text. Supported: text/plain, application/json, text/x.enum.

responseSchema.description: Output schema for generated candidate text (OpenAPI schema subset). Used with application/json responseMimeType.

responseModalities.description: Set of response modalities the model can return.

candidateCount.description: Number of generated responses to return.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens in the response.

temperature.description: Controls randomness of the output. Range: [0.0, 2.0].

topP.description: Maximum cumulative probability of tokens to consider when sampling.

topK.description: Maximum number of tokens to consider when sampling.

presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty applied to tokens already in the response.

frequencyPenalty.description: Frequency penalty applied proportionally to token usage count.

thinkingConfig.description: Configuration for thinking features (supported models only).

includeThoughts.description: Whether to include thoughts in the response.

thinkingBudget.description: Number of thought tokens the model should generate.

tools.description: A list of Tools the model may use to generate the next response.

codeExecution.description: Tool that executes code generated by the model.

safetySettings.description: Safety settings to block unsafe content.

cachedContent.description: The name of the cached content to use. Format: cachedContents/{cachedContent}

thought.description: Whether this part is a thinking/reasoning step.

post.description: Generates a streamed response from the model given an input GenerateContentRequest. Use query parameter `alt=sse` for server-sent events streaming.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model to use for content generation.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.description: Set to 'sse' for server-sent events streaming format.
